deal.product: Nimbus Agents (AI agents for invoice & ops automation)

calls.title: Discovery
calls.transcript:
Rep (Arjun): What does invoice handling look like today?
Priya Nair (Ops Director, Kestrel): About 4,000 invoices a month, all manual matching. My team burns roughly 14 hours a week on exceptions.
Arjun: What's the cost of that?
Priya: Two full-time people, plus late-payment fees. Honestly I can't judge your pricing yet - your site just says 'contact sales'. And my CFO Anita Desai owns budget, she isn't on this call.
Arjun: Understood, I'll send a usage-based estimate.
Priya: Please. Also I'm not a fan of long contracts.

calls.title: Security review
calls.transcript:
Rahul Menon (CISO, Kestrel) joins.
Rahul: Before any agent touches vendor bank details, we need SOC 2 Type II and full audit logs of every agent action.
Arjun: We're SOC 2 Type II certified. Logs are exportable.
Rahul: Exportable isn't enough. I need per-action lineage: which data, which model, who approved. Data must stay in the India region.
Priya: Rahul can veto this whole thing.
Arjun: I'll get you our lineage documentation.

calls.title: Competitor comparison
calls.transcript:
Priya: We're also evaluating Relay AI. Their demo was slick and they quoted 20% cheaper.
Arjun: What did you like about Relay?
Priya: Fast setup, one week. But Rahul said Relay couldn't show per-action audit trails.
Arjun: We can. Would a side-by-side help?
Priya: Yes, but Anita will only care about payback period. Send numbers for our 4,000 invoices.

calls.title: Explainability objection
calls.transcript:
Rahul: How do we know the agent isn't hallucinating a payment approval? Explain how it reaches a decision.
Arjun: Every decision shows the evidence, confidence, and a human-approval step above your threshold.
Rahul: Show me a live trace. And I want a pilot with human review before full rollout.
Priya: A pilot would also calm Anita. She hates big upfront commitments.
Arjun: We can run a 30-day pilot on one invoice queue.

calls.title: Close attempt (upcoming)
calls.transcript: UPCOMING CALL - not yet held. Anita Desai (CFO) joins for the first time to decide on budget.

playbook.note: CISO objected on audit trails. Rep ran a live per-action lineage demo in the security call. Deal advanced within a week and closed.
Buyer raised pricing vs cheaper competitor. Rep offered a discount first and never quantified ROI. Buyer chose the cheaper vendor.
CFO was skeptical of upfront commitment. Rep built an ROI calculator using the customer's own invoice volume and offered a 30-day pilot. CFO approved.
